calibration.rationale: Keep P0/T4 measurement protocol: prefill warmup=100/repeat=1000; decode warmup=10/repeat=200. Every timed decode call advances B independent batch-one caches once, serially in one process; prefill and cache setup are outside timing. Reuse immutable past caches so every sample starts at the same context length, without rollover. The empirical perturbation floor is a reference, not a significance guarantee.
